summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of Costume Inventory Tracker (no-auth). 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (including Emergent object storage upload + image retrieval). Frontend Playwright E2E covers dashboard tiles, inventory filters/views, add-costume dialog (including size total computation, custom location, category select), search filter, list/grid toggle, costume detail page, delete flow, and locations page CRUD. All critical flows pass.

minor.issue: POST /api/categories silently returns existing category (with id) when name already exists instead of returning 409. Functional but inconsistent with /api/locations which returns 409 on duplicate. Acceptable but worth aligning.

Field is total_items (sum of all size qty) and categories list is derived from costumes only (not from /api/categories collection); category_count therefore reflects only categories in use. Document or align with frontend expectation.
No safeguard preventing deletion of a seeded/in-use location; deleting a location used by costumes leaves orphan strings in costume.location (free-text is allowed so this is acceptable, just note).

issues: When toast appears, the 'Locations' top-nav text gets overlapped by the success toast (cosmetic only).

action_items: Optional: align POST /api/categories duplicate behaviour with POST /api/locations (return 409 on exact duplicate).
Optional: document /api/stats semantics (total_items vs total_costumes) in API docs.
Optional: consider preventing deletion of in-use locations or warning the user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager for forward compatibility.

MIME_TYPES dict is defined but only used as a fallback when UploadFile.content_type is missing; works fine. Consider validating extension against allowed image types to reject non-images at /api/upload (currently relies only on storage to accept the bytes).

/api/upload uses synchronous `requests` inside async route handlers (put_object/get_object). Under load this will block the event loop. Recommend switching to httpx.AsyncClient or running in a thread executor.
init_storage() retries on 403 in put/get_object but if storage_key never refreshes (still 403), the second call will also fail with HTTPException 503 — acceptable behaviour but no jitter/backoff.

list_costumes returns Pydantic Costume objects via FastAPI response_model, but the underlying mongo docs are returned raw — relies on Pydantic to filter. Fine, but the `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')` should also be set on Costume to be safe (it is — good).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed costumes/locations/categories during pytest runs. Frontend e2e created and deleted 'PW Costume <ts>' and added 'PW Test Loc <ts>' (left behind on locations page intentionally for verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are parallel-safe (use unique TEST_/PW_ prefixes). Frontend has data-testid attributes on all key elements as specified. /api/upload depends on Emergent object store (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) — it worked in this iteration; the test skips automatically with 503. Inventory list-view toggle works (verified in a second pass) — initial timing flake during fetchAll is not a real bug.
